counterfactual_text: The orange-juice stream raises the glass level while the bottle level remains unchanged throughout the transfer.
positive_text: The orange juice forms a continuous stream into the glass as the bottle level falls and the glass level rises together.
semantic_text: A bottle pours orange juice through a visible stream into a glass until the bottle holds less and the glass holds more. Required visible entities: one bottle containing orange juice; one glass; level support surface. At the beginning: bottle: intact with a clearly visible initial orange-juice level; glass: intact, empty, and separated from the bottle opening. Required state changes: bottle juice level: higher to lower; glass juice level: lower to higher; orange-juice configuration: bottle to stream and glass. These event variables are allowed to change: bottle orientation; bottle juice level; glass juice level; orange-juice stream shape. Preserve throughout: static side-view camera; bottle and glass identities; orange-juice color and neutral background; one bottle; one glass; the same orange juice and scene.
